scope: map/gametype override now actually reaches the client; other maps need their fastfiles

bug_found_and_fixed.symptom: --gamestate-map mp_afghan produced mapname=mp_afghan inside the gamestate payload, but configstring 0 and the connectResponse still said mp_cross_fire, so the client kept showing 交叉火力
bug_found_and_fixed.root_cause: configstring 0 was taken from the constant DEFAULT_CONFIGSTRINGS, connectResponse used DEFAULT_MAP, and the start log used DEFAULT_MAP
fix: build configstring 0 from the configured map/gametype (_configstrings_for)
use the configured map in connectResponse and in the start log
gametype falls back to DEFAULT_GAMETYPE ('war') instead of 'mp' so the string matches the previously working value
bug_found_and_fixed.verification: start log now reports map=mp_afghan and configstring 0 is \g_gametype\war\mapname\mp_afghan

new_capability: tools/run_match.py --map NAME passes the map through to the game server

findings.mp_cross_fire: unchanged - states 9 -> 10 -> 10 -> 0 with all steps true (regression run regress2)
findings.mp_afghan: the client disconnects early (state 0, then the process exits) - this runtime does not carry the afghan fastfiles, so the map override cannot be exercised beyond crossfire today
